_about: Slide order (41 physical positions, BUILD_BRIEF §4 / script §2.7) and the group partials. Owned by the foundation. tools/assemble.cjs places each slide by this order, wherever its group file defines it.
_presenters: Team size: 2 or 3. The ONE number for Part II and the title slide. With 2, every data-member="3" element is left out and S17b stays in place as an unused slot (hidden, not exported). Override for one build: node tools/assemble.cjs --presenters 3 --out slides/.tmp-team3.html
_options: Team options (true or false). nemawashi: true only if the team really held its December talks with classmates (script §2.3); then S11D gets the mouse chip "our nemawashi" and its card (data-option="nemawashi"); false leaves both out. Override for one build: node tools/assemble.cjs --option nemawashi=on --out slides/.tmp-nema.html
_export: Static exports (engine data-export, set on the slide by assemble): S20E is the live end copy of S20, so the PDF leaves it out; the PPTX keeps it so a slide show does not end on black. Auto bridges (S04z) and unused member slots are left out of both by the engine itself.
